commits.message:
feat(click): a click's config writes are changes its turn returns, which the host performs, and the next click waits for them to land (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.axx)

The renderer no longer writes a config file. A writer reads the file as the
click's own changes on their way leave it, and lands its write as a change at
settings, each carrying what it read; the host performs every turn's changes
in answer order, thrown turns included, refusing a change whose setting moved,
and settles each with an effect-done. A journal turn opens only once the
changes ahead of it have landed. The landing's turn reloads the clicking
session and sets up any lane its reload moved; a change that did not land is
held on the session's warning, and the session's history stops stepping the
file, so undo brings back what the click released.

A change to or from a file that does not parse replaces it whole, guarded by
its bytes. Spec section 7 states the change's shape and how the renderer
stands in for discovery until the config chain is handed in.
feat(config): a config write is a list of changes at settings, each carrying what it read, and applying them refuses a setting that moved (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.axx)
docs(click): no comment names load-config or toolbar-toggle, which are gone (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.axx)

refactor(click): load-config and toolbar-toggle are deleted, so a session's config is only what its client named (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.axx)

No draw emits either verb. A load-config pick stored an absolute path in
session state and let a click redirect which file a session reads and
writes, so the renderer's home and the file the host will write could
disagree. With the pick gone, no click moves a session's origin, and the
render cache's follow, the views port and the pick's config-target source
go with it. A session uses another file through --config or
CC_CANDYBAR_CONFIG.
docs(spec): A-1's open item says a request waits for the renderer's thread, not for turns taken one at a time (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.cwq) (#767)
